lines.text: As fast as light? A top expert once guessed it was.
lines.phonemes: az fˈast az lˈaɪt? ɐ tˈɒp ˈɛkspɜːt wˈʌns ɡˈɛst ɪt wˈɒz.

lines.text: It's a nerve signal, racing down one cell's thin fibre. Some fibres reach from spine to toe: about a metre. How long does that take?
lines.phonemes: ɪts ɐ nˈɜːv sˈɪɡnəl, ɹˈeɪsɪŋ dˌaʊn wˈɒn sˈɛlz θˈɪn fˈaɪbə. sˌʌm fˈaɪbəz ɹˈiːtʃ fɹɒm spˈaɪn tə tˈəʊ: ɐbˌaʊt ɐ mˈiːtə. hˌaʊ lˈɒŋ dˈʌz ðat tˈeɪk?

lines.text: That was Johannes Müller, who doubted it could be timed. In eighteen fifty, his former student Helmholtz timed it. About thirty metres a second: cheetah speed.
lines.phonemes: ðɐt wˈɒz jəʊhˈanɪs mˈuːlə, hˌuː dˈaʊtɪd ɪt kʊd biː tˈaɪmd. ɪn ˈeɪtiːn fˈɪfti, hɪz fˈɔːmə stjˈuːdənt hˈɛlmhəʊltz tˈaɪmd ɪt. ɐbˌaʊt θˈɜːti mˈiːtəz ɐ sˈɛkənd: tʃˈiːtə spˈiːd.

lines.text: It isn't current in a wire: the cell re-fires it, step by step. Many fibres wear a fatty coat, myelin, and only re-fire at its gaps, so the signal leaps. Where it's damaged, as in multiple sclerosis, signals slow or stall.
lines.phonemes: ɪt ˌɪzənt kˈʌɹənt ɪn ɐ wˈaɪə: ðə sˈɛl ɹˌiːfˈaɪəz ɪt, stˈɛp baɪ stˈɛp. mˈɛni fˈaɪbəz wˈeəɹ ɐ fˈati kˈəʊt, mˈaɪɪlˌɪn, and ˈəʊnli ɹˌiːfˈaɪəɹ at ɪts ɡˈaps, sˌəʊ ðə sˈɪɡnəl lˈiːps. wˌeəɹ ɪts dˈamɪdʒd, az ɪn mˌʌltɪpəl skləɹˈəʊsɪs, sˈɪɡnəlz slˈəʊ ɔː stˈɔːl.

lines.text: The thinnest bare fibres crawl at about a metre a second. Thick wrapped ones, up to a hundred and fifty. Faster than a Formula One car.
lines.phonemes: ðə θˈɪnɪst bˈeə fˈaɪbəz kɹˈɔːl at ɐbˌaʊt ɐ mˈiːtəɹ ɐ sˈɛkənd. θˈɪk ɹˈapt wˌɒnz, ˌʌp tʊ ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd and fˈɪfti. fˈastə ðˌanə fˈɔːmjʊlə wˈɒn kˈɑː.

lines.text: So a stubbed toe can hurt twice. The jolt takes fast fibres; the ache takes slow ones.
lines.phonemes: sˌəʊ ɐ stˈʌbd tˈəʊ kan hˈɜːt twˈaɪs. ðə dʒˈəʊlt tˈeɪks fˈast fˈaɪbəz; ðɪ ˈeɪk tˈeɪks slˈəʊ wˌɒnz.

lines.text: Meanwhile, as you watched, a heart at rest beat about eighty times. Each began with a spark.
lines.phonemes: mˈiːnwaɪl, az juː wˈɒtʃt, ɐ hˈɑːt at ɹˈɛst bˈiːt ɐbˌaʊt ˈeɪti tˈaɪmz. ˈiːtʃ bɪɡˈan wɪð ɐ spˈɑːk.

lines.text: Next: the end of the line. A gap most signals can't jump.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ðɪ ˈɛnd ɒvðə lˈaɪn. ɐ ɡˈap mˈəʊst sˈɪɡnəlz kˈɑːnt dʒˈʌmp.
